ElementSelector.description: The objects a rule selects: `ArchUnitNET`'s `Types()`, `Classes()`, ..., then `That()`.

includeReferenced.description: Also select the types the code references but does not define (`Types(true)`). Default false.

kind.description: `Types()`, `Classes()`, `Interfaces()`, `Attributes()`, `Members()`, `FieldMembers()`, `MethodMembers()`, `PropertyMembers()`; `function` and `module` are TypeScript and Python additions.

language.description: Only objects of these languages: scopes a rule that uses a key some language cannot answer (ADR-0014).

conditionNames.description: Conditions to match in an export map.

mainFiles.description: File names tried for a directory.

FileReference.description: A configuration file the extractor reads: `tsConfig`, `babelConfig`.

fileName.description: Path, relative to the working directory.

FilterOption.description: `focus`, `reaches`, `highlight`: the pattern form or the compound form.

depth.description: `focus.depth`: how many steps of neighbours to show. Default 1.

path.description: The paths the filter matches, joined.

FilterValue.description: A filter in any of its three forms.

assembly.description:
Rulebearing addition, native configurations only. Patterns the .NET assembly name must
match (`CleanArchitecture.Web`, not the file name): the `assembly` of the types the code
layer declares in the module's file.

assemblyNot.description:
Rulebearing addition, native configurations only. Patterns the assembly name must not
match; a module the code layer places no type in does not match.

language.description:
Rulebearing addition, native configurations only. The languages the module must be in
(`typescript`, `javascript`, `dotnet`, `python`), one or a list; compared with the
module's `language`.

namespace.description:
Rulebearing addition, native configurations only. Patterns, any of which one of the
module's `namespaces[]` must match (.NET namespaces; Python dotted module names).

namespaceNot.description:
Rulebearing addition, native configurations only. Patterns none of the module's
`namespaces[]` may match; a module without `namespaces` does not match.

orphan.description: Match modules with no edges in or out.

pathNot.description: Paths the source must not match.

project.description:
Rulebearing addition, native configurations only. Patterns the module's `project` must
match: the `.csproj` (or loaded assembly) path for .NET, the top-level package for Python.

projectNot.description:
Rulebearing addition, native configurations only. Patterns the module's `project` must
not match; a module without `project` does not match.

pattern.description:
A path pattern with exactly one capturing group naming the module, for example
`^apps/web/src/features/([^/]+)/`.

KnownViolation.description:
One `knownViolations` entry: dependency-cruiser's shape, or a Rulebearing id with lifecycle
fields.

cycle.description: The cycle, for a cycle violation.

expires.description: The last day the exception applies.

id.description: The stable id, when Rulebearing wrote the entry.

reason.description: Why the exception stands, and what removes it.

via.description: The via chain, for a reachability violation.

allowEmpty.description: Opt out of liveness for every expanded rule.

fix.description: The fix shared by every expanded rule.

layers.description:
Path patterns from the highest layer to the lowest; a lower layer may not depend on a
higher one.

name.description: The rule name; each expanded rule is `<name>:<lower>-to-<higher>`.

severity.description: Severity of every expanded rule. Default `error`.

ModuleRestriction.description: `module`: the restriction of a dependents rule or a required rule.

numberOfDependentsLessThan.description: Match modules with fewer matching dependents than this.

numberOfDependentsMoreThan.description: Match modules with more matching dependents than this.

typescript.description: The TypeScript and JavaScript extractor's options (dependency-cruiser's flat option names).

diagrams.description: Diagram rules: types that must adhere to a `PlantUML` component diagram.

adhereTo.description: The `PlantUML` component diagram, relative to the configuration (`AdhereToPlantUmlDiagram`).

allowEmpty.description: An empty selection is not vacuous. Default false (ADR-0007).

comment.description: Why the rule exists; the decision token (`adr:NNNN`) goes here.

expires.description: The last day the rule applies, YYYY-MM-DD; the run fails the day after, as for a dependency rule.

fix.description: What to do about a violation; every reporter prints it.

name.description: The rule's name, unique in the configuration.

elements.description:
Element rules: `ArchUnitNET`'s predicates and conditions over types, members and modules
of every language, each key's per-language answer in its description.

allowEmpty.description: An empty selection passes (`WithoutRequiringPositiveResults()`). Default false: it is vacuous (ADR-0007).

comment.description: Why the rule exists; the decision token (`adr:NNNN`) goes here.

expires.description: The last day the rule applies, YYYY-MM-DD; the run fails the day after, as for a dependency rule.

fix.description: What to do about a violation; every reporter prints it.

name.description: The rule's name, unique in the configuration.

independence.description: Independence contracts, expanded to one `$1` fence each.

layers.description: Layer models, expanded to one `forbidden` rule per lower-to-higher pair.

ratchets.description: Counts of direct edges that may only fall.

slices.description: Slice rules: types grouped by a namespace, module or path pattern.

allowEmpty.description: An empty slicing is not vacuous.

comment.description: Why the rule exists; the decision token (`adr:NNNN`) goes here.

expires.description: The last day the rule applies, YYYY-MM-DD; the run fails the day after, as for a dependency rule.

fix.description: What to do about a violation; every reporter prints it.

matching.description: `Matching("Ns.(*)")` or `MatchingWithPackages("Ns.(**)")`: a namespace, dotted module or path pattern; either names a slice by what follows the prefix, and `Ns.(**)..` by its first segment.

name.description: The rule's name, unique in the configuration.

segments.description: Keep the first this many segments of each slice name, so a package and everything below it are one slice (import-linter's `acyclic_siblings`). A Rulebearing addition.

where.description: A pattern a slice name must match to take part.

OptionsSchema.description: `options`: the TypeScript block's keys and every other dependency-cruiser option.

babelConfig.description: The Babel config whose aliases apply.

baseDir.description: Paths in the output are relative to this directory. Default: the working directory.

builtInModules.description: Changes to the runtime's built-in module list.

cache.description: Accepted and recorded; the content-addressed cache is wave 3.

collapse.description: `collapse`: a pattern or a folder depth.

combinedDependencies.description: Whether every `package.json` up the tree counts for npm classification. Default: `false`.

detectJSDocImports.description: Whether JSDoc imports are dependencies. Default: `false`.

doNotFollow.description: Modules to record but not follow.

exoticRequireStrings.description: Names other than `require` that load a module.

experimentalStats.description: Whether to record size and statement counts. Default: `false`.

extraExtensionsToScan.description: Extensions to scan beyond the parser's own.

focus.description: `focus`: a pattern, a list, or `{ path, depth }`.

highlight.description: `highlight`: a pattern, a list, or `{ path }`.

knownViolations.description: Violations to report at a lower severity, keyed by stable id or by rule, from and to.

maxDepth.description: How deep to follow from the roots; `0` is unlimited. Default: `0`.

moduleSystems.description: Which dependency forms to extract. Default: `es6`, `cjs`, `tsd`, `amd`.

parser.description:
Which parser dependency-cruiser would have used. Default: `acorn`, or `tsc` for
TypeScript sources.

prefix.description: The link prefix reporters put before a path.

preserveSymlinks.description: Whether symlinks keep their own path. Default: `false`.

reaches.description: `reaches`: a pattern, a list, or `{ path }`.

suffix.description: The link suffix reporters put after a path.

tsConfig.description: The tsconfig to resolve `paths` and `baseUrl` from.

tsPreCompilationDeps.description: Whether edges that disappear after compilation are kept. Default: `false`.

PathFilter.description: `doNotFollow`, `exclude` and `includeOnly`: either patterns or the compound form.

anyOf.description: Several expressions, matched as an alternation.

Patterns.description: One regular expression or several, dependency-cruiser's `REAsStringsType`.

roots.description: Import roots. Default: `src` when it exists, else the working directory.

version.description: The Python version whose standard library is `stdlib`. Default: `3.13`.

Ratchet.description:
`rules.ratchets[]`: a count of direct edges that may only fall
([FR-RULE-06](../../../docs/prd.md#fr-rule-06)).

fix.description: The imperative to follow when the count rises.

to.description: Targets to count to; `$1` substitutes from `from.path`.

Rule.description: One dependency rule, in dependency-cruiser's shape plus the native metadata.

comment.description: Why the rule exists; carries the decision token.

examples.description: Edges that must pass and edges that must fail; `rulebearing test` runs them.

expires.description: The last day the rule applies; the run fails the day after.

fix.description: The imperative to follow when the rule fires.

from.description: The selecting side of a dependency rule.

module.description: The module restriction of a dependents or required rule.

oneOf.description: The default: the rule compares modules.
The rule compares folders.
`"specify"`.

ancestor.description: Match targets in a folder above the source.

assembly.description:
Rulebearing addition, native configurations only. Patterns the .NET assembly name must
match (`CleanArchitecture.Web`, not the file name): the `assembly` of the types the code
layer declares in the module's file.

assemblyNot.description:
Rulebearing addition, native configurations only. Patterns the assembly name must not
match; a module the code layer places no type in does not match.

dependencyKind.description:
Rulebearing addition, native configurations only. The kinds of reference, any of which
the edge's `dependencyKind` must be (`import`, `inherits`, `implements`, `field`,
`signature`, `body`, `attribute`, `generic-argument`, `typeof`, `call`), one or a list.
A property of the edge, so it sits on `to` only.

dependencyKindNot.description:
Rulebearing addition, native configurations only. The kinds of reference the edge's
`dependencyKind` may not be; an edge without `dependencyKind` does not match.

dependencyTypes.description: Dependency types, any of which matches.

dependencyTypesNot.description: Dependency types, none of which may be present.

exoticRequire.description: The exotic require names to match.

exoticRequireNot.description: The exotic require names not to match.

exoticallyRequired.description: Match edges formed by an exotic require.

language.description:
Rulebearing addition, native configurations only. The languages the module must be in
(`typescript`, `javascript`, `dotnet`, `python`), one or a list; compared with the
module's `language`.

moreThanOneDependencyType.description: Match edges whose target is depended on in more than one way.

moreUnstable.description: Match targets more unstable than the source (needs `metrics`, wave 2).

namespace.description:
Rulebearing addition, native configurations only. Patterns, any of which one of the
module's `namespaces[]` must match (.NET namespaces; Python dotted module names).

namespaceNot.description:
Rulebearing addition, native configurations only. Patterns none of the module's
`namespaces[]` may match; a module without `namespaces` does not match.

path.description: Paths the target must match; `$0` to `$9` substitute captures from `from.path`.

pathNot.description: Paths the target must not match.

preCompilationOnly.description: Match edges that disappear after compilation.

project.description:
Rulebearing addition, native configurations only. Patterns the module's `project` must
match: the `.csproj` (or loaded assembly) path for .NET, the top-level package for Python.

projectNot.description:
Rulebearing addition, native configurations only. Patterns the module's `project` must
not match; a module without `project` does not match.

reachable.description: Reachability: match modules the `from` modules reach (or do not reach).

via.description: Cycle members, some of which match.

viaOnly.description: Cycle members, all of which match.

anyOf.description: Include (`true`) or drop (`false`) edges that vanish after compilation.
Include them and mark each with `preCompilationOnly`.

TypeScriptOptions.description: `languages.typescript`, and dependency-cruiser's flat options that alias into it.

babelConfig.description: The Babel config whose aliases apply.

baseDir.description: Paths in the output are relative to this directory. Default: the working directory.

builtInModules.description: Changes to the runtime's built-in module list.

combinedDependencies.description: Whether every `package.json` up the tree counts for npm classification. Default: `false`.

detectJSDocImports.description: Whether JSDoc imports are dependencies. Default: `false`.

doNotFollow.description: Modules to record but not follow.

exoticRequireStrings.description: Names other than `require` that load a module.

experimentalStats.description: Whether to record size and statement counts. Default: `false`.

extraExtensionsToScan.description: Extensions to scan beyond the parser's own.

maxDepth.description: How deep to follow from the roots; `0` is unlimited. Default: `0`.

moduleSystems.description: Which dependency forms to extract. Default: `es6`, `cjs`, `tsd`, `amd`.

parser.description:
Which parser dependency-cruiser would have used. Default: `acorn`, or `tsc` for
TypeScript sources.

preserveSymlinks.description: Whether symlinks keep their own path. Default: `false`.

tsConfig.description: The tsconfig to resolve `paths` and `baseUrl` from.

tsPreCompilationDeps.description: Whether edges that disappear after compilation are kept. Default: `false`.

dependencyTypes.description: Dependency types a step must have.

dependencyTypesNot.description: Dependency types a step must not have.

ViaRestriction.description: `via` and `viaOnly`: the pattern form or the object form.

arguments.description: The `arguments` passed to a function-shaped config.

env.description: The `env` passed to a function-shaped config.

fileName.description: Path, relative to the working directory.

$schema.description: The schema this file is written against.

allowEmpty.description:
The rules allowed to match nothing: names of dependency rules (`allowed[N]` for the Nth
`allowed` entry), ratchets, and element, slice and diagram rules. A name that is none of
these is an error, so an exception cannot outlive its rule (ADR-0032).

allowed.description: dependency-cruiser's `allowed`, legal at the same place.

allowedSeverity.description: dependency-cruiser's `allowedSeverity`, legal at the same place.

defines.description: Named values read from JSON files, substituted into patterns as `${name}`.

extends.description:
Files, npm packages, `dependency-cruiser/configs/<preset>` or `rulebearing:<preset>` to
extend; later entries are merged under earlier ones and this file wins.

forbidden.description: dependency-cruiser's `forbidden`, legal at the same place.

required.description: dependency-cruiser's `required`, legal at the same place.
